summary: The exact candidate change hardens authentication cookie names and duplicate handling, adds a private browser nonce for callback state, and covers sibling-domain injection in tests. No actionable defect was found in the reviewed files.

evidence: src/auth_hub.ts:146-173 defines __Host- production cookie names and strips the prefix only for HTTP loopback requests.
src/auth_hub.ts:352-389 and 916-934 key the server-side auth record by SHA-256 of the URL state plus a private browser nonce, so the callback requires both values.
src/auth_hub.ts:559-603 and 957-1025 keep MCP intent and auth values opaque, emit Secure and Path=/ without Domain, and reject duplicate cookie names through singleCookieValue.
src/auth_hub_test.ts:660-1021 and src/agent_mcp_http_test.ts:861-929 add sibling-domain injection, duplicate, cross-origin callback, and MCP navigation regressions.
